sentences.en: The journalist was too upset to distinguish vice from virtue.
sentences.zh: 记者太情绪化了，无法分辨好坏。

sentences.en: This jacket has the virtue of being easy to wash.
sentences.zh: 这件夹克的优点是容易清洗。

sentences.en: He got the job by virtue of his father's connections.
sentences.zh: 他凭借父亲的关系得到了这份工作。

senses.zh: 美德，德行；优点，长处；贞操，贞德
